result.instruction: In the busy bit-boundary logic, replace the variable-index read `data_reg[bit_index]` with `data_reg[0]`, and shift the captured byte toward bit 0 on each data-bit boundary so bits are still transmitted least-significant first. Keep the existing `bit_index` and `bit_count` frame timing, and ensure shifting occurs only after the old bit 0 is used; preserve the stop bit, completion edge, reset values, and all registered output behavior. Retain the top interface and matching latency annotation, then compare routed LUTs against the 22-LUT verified best under the same constraints.
